        for pos in range(n):
            # +1

            diff = new_d - digits[pos]
            if diff != 0:

            # -1
            new_d = (digits[pos] - 1) % 3
            diff = new_d - digits[pos]
            if diff != 0:
                ball.append(i + diff * powers[pos])
        balls[i] = ball
